description: The exact weights, engine and serving setup behind every v5 board run (evals/v5_board.py validates it and renders the 'Weights used' block of docs/RESULTS.md). A board run names its entry with "weights_id" in board.json. A row on the board is a model AND its exact weights, engine and harness: a different quantization (another bpw, another variant, another pack) is a NEW entry here and a different board row, never an edit of an existing entry. Fields: repo + revision are a Hugging Face repo id and its full commit SHA when the weights are on the Hub (revision_kind "hub"); a pack that is not on the Hub has repo null, its local id in local_id and OpenBeast's local content id in revision (revision_kind "local"). A single file pinned by its sha256 is revision_kind "file-sha256": with its Hub repo (and the commit it was checked at, in revision) when it is on the Hub, or with repo null and derived_from (the source it was built from) when it was converted or built locally. "unverified" means we could not prove the value from a record; never guess one. Entries with no board run yet (runs: none) are recorded for when they get one.
